name: Spell Server of the Robot Master (Commercial)

description.value:
This steel box features colorful cascading LED lights, a convenient carrying handle, and a deep indentation in the side with a universal charging port. The indentation can accommodate a single minibot, which is linked to the spell server of the robot master.

Activate—Direct Minibot 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect You turn some dials and flick some levers to activate the linked minibot. You Activate Minibot for the linked minibot.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Analyze Target]

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Mending], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Mindlink]

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Inject Nanobots], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Logic Bomb]
